title: Minimizing Finger Pain via Correct Guitar Finger Placement
summary: This JustinGuitar lesson demonstrates how finger placement within a fret affects the amount of pressure needed to produce a clean note, with a practical exercise to train beginners to minimize finger pain. The instructor explains that moving the finger closer to the fret reduces the required pressure, and compares pressing near the front of the fret versus toward the back. The session guides the learner through a controlled exercise: place the first finger on the fifth fret of the third string, pluck with the thumb to assess note quality under light pressure, then move the finger toward the back of the fret to feel the increased effort required. The goal is to help beginners produce good notes with less finger pain, enabling longer, more enjoyable practice sessions.
topics: exercise: first finger on fifth fret, third string
minimizing pain to increase practice time
